name: cart
title: Cart
summary: One cart across the Official Store and marketplace sellers for customers and guests. Every line is bound to the exact offer the customer chose, lines are grouped into seller packages with delivery estimates and shipping, and every read re-checks price, stock and eligibility so changes are explained per item instead of discarding the cart.
owns: Customer carts and guest carts (guest session), one active cart per owner
Merging a guest cart into the customer cart on sign-in, with a per-line merge report
Cart lines bound to an explicit offer (seller, condition, variant); a seller is never switched silently
Grouping lines into seller packages with ship-from, delivery estimate, shipping cost and return terms per package
Quantity limits: offer purchase limit, available stock and a platform line maximum
Change detection on every read: price increased or decreased, out of stock, reduced quantity, offer ended, seller restricted, not shippable to the chosen location, with a notice per item
Preserving eligible items while one item is unavailable (unavailable lines stay visible and are excluded from checkout)
Coupon preview in the cart (applied amount, covered items, rejection reason)
Deliver-to location used for cart estimates
notOwns: Prices, conditions, purchase limits and offer status: offers
Stock quantities and reservations: inventory (the cart never reserves stock; checkout does at Place order)
Delivery estimates, shipping rates and coverage: shipping
Coupon rules and discount allocation: promotions (the cart only previews)
Final totals, tax, revalidation and order placement: checkout

publicApi.name: getCartForCheckout
publicApi.desc: Eligible lines (offer, seller, variant, quantity, accepted unit price, package key) and coupon codes, after a fresh change check. Unavailable lines are returned separately so checkout can explain them.

publicApi.name: removePurchasedItems
publicApi.signature: (cartId: uuid, itemIds: uuid[], orderId: uuid) => void
publicApi.desc: Remove lines that became an accepted order; other lines stay. Marks the cart converted when it becomes empty.

publicApi.name: restoreItems
publicApi.desc: Put lines back after a declined payment on an order that was pending, so the customer can pay another way without rebuilding the cart.

publicApi.name: addLine
publicApi.signature: (owner: { customerId?: uuid, guestSessionId?: uuid }, line: { offerId: uuid, quantity: int }) => CartItem
publicApi.desc: Add an offer to the shopper's cart, creating the cart if needed; same rules as POST /cart/items (an offer already in the cart increases its quantity, capped at the limit). Publishes cart.item.added.

publicApi.name: countOfferInCarts
publicApi.desc: How many active carts hold an offer (used to warn a seller before ending an offer).

publicApi.name: getCartView
publicApi.desc: The shopper's cart grouped by package, after a fresh price, stock and eligibility check (same as GET /cart)

id.desc: Seller id; null for the Official Store (as in offers)

addressId.desc: Saved customer address the location came from

source.desc: default_region = no location known; estimates use the market default and the summary says shipping and tax depend on the address

kind.desc: What changed since the customer added or last accepted the line. terms_changed: the offer's return, warranty or dispatch terms changed (OfferChange kind terms: offers termsVersion above acceptedTermsVersion); a warning the customer accepts, which moves acceptedTermsVersion to the current version

severity.desc: blocking = the line is excluded from checkout until resolved; warning = included only after the customer accepts; info = shown once

message.desc: Customer-facing sentence, e.g. 'Price changed since you added it: was $94.99, now $99.99. Northwind Audio updated this offer on Oct 8.'

changedBy.desc: Seller name when the seller changed the offer

alternatives.desc: Other offers for the same variant and condition. Shown as a link; never applied automatically

actions.desc: Actions the UI offers. notify_me needs the wishlist module (phase 3)

maxQuantity.desc: min(offer purchase limit, deal purchase limit from promotions, available stock, maxQuantityPerLine setting)

purchaseLimit.desc: Offer limit per customer, shown as 'Limit 3 per customer'

availableQuantity.desc: Only shown when low or below the requested quantity

compareAtPrice.desc: Was price with its basis, from offers/promotions

acceptedUnitPrice.desc: Price the customer added or last accepted; the baseline for change detection

acceptedTermsVersion.desc: offers termsVersion the customer last saw; a higher version triggers a re-check through offers.revalidate

serviceNotices.desc: Holiday or service interruption notes from shipping

key.desc: Stable grouping key: owner type + seller id + fulfilledBy + ship-from (offers Offer.shipping: fulfilledBy and dispatch.shipsFrom), so a seller's Marketly-fulfilled and self-shipped items are separate packages

fulfilledBy.desc: marketly_service packages read 'Ships from Marketly' and are quoted with the service profile

delivery.desc: Null when every item in the package is unavailable or shipping is disabled

returnTerms.desc: Summary of the seller's return terms for these items

notShippable.desc: The seller does not ship to the deliver-to location

label.desc: e.g. '$20 off your first order over $100'

reason.desc: Why it was rejected, in plain words

coverage.desc: Items that receive the discount and their share

reason.desc: 'Already on sale' or 'Not included in this coupon' (the same wording at checkout)

taxNote.desc: 'Calculated after you enter an address' (tax is computed in checkout)

id.desc: The cart's id; null when the owner has no cart yet (GET /cart creates nothing and answers an empty view)

checkoutReady.desc: At least one eligible line and no warning notice left unaccepted

retentionNote.desc: 'Items stay in your cart for 30 days. Prices and stock are checked again at checkout.'

checkedAt.desc: When prices and stock were last re-read

outcome.desc: capped_at_limit includes the maximum in the message

savedItemsMoved.desc: Guest saved-for-later items moved to the customer (an offer the customer already saved is kept once)

message.desc: Shown once after sign-in, e.g. 'We added 2 items from before you signed in'

stateMachines.name: Cart lifecycle
stateMachines.notes: merge: a guest cart is folded into the customer cart on sign-in. convert: the last eligible lines became an accepted order. restore: a pending payment was declined and checkout put the lines back. A cart with unavailable lines left after an order stays active.

stateMachines.name: Cart line availability
stateMachines.notes: Derived on every read from open notices. needs_attention lines are included in checkout only after the customer accepts (price increase) or reduces quantity. unavailable lines (out of stock, offer ended, seller unavailable, not shippable) stay in the cart, are excluded from checkout and never replaced by another seller's offer. Price decreases are info notices and accepted automatically.

endpoints.summary: Cart grouped by package, with change detection
endpoints.desc: Every call re-reads offers, stock and coverage for all lines (batched) and returns per-item notices. Unavailable lines stay in their package with includedInCheckout=false. Creates nothing; an owner without a cart gets an empty view.

postalCode.desc: Override the deliver-to location for this read only

endpoints.summary: Item count and attention count for the header and app tab bar
Add an offer to the cart (Add to cart)
endpoints.desc: Adding an offer already in the cart increases its quantity. Adding a different offer for the same variant creates a second line; the existing line is never switched. Quantity above the maximum is capped with outcome capped_at_limit.

endpoints.summary: Accept a changed price or reduced quantity for a line
endpoints.desc: Moves the accepted price baseline to the current price (or the quantity to what is available) and closes the warning notices. Blocking notices cannot be accepted.

endpoints.summary: Replace a line's offer with one the customer explicitly chose
endpoints.desc: Only on an explicit customer action (e.g. 'See other offers' then Choose). Must be the same variant. The response shows the new seller, price and package.

endpoints.summary: Remove every unavailable line in one action
Set the deliver-to location used for estimates
endpoints.desc: Either a saved address (customers) or a postal code. Checkout starts from this location but asks for a full address.

endpoints.summary: Apply a coupon code for preview
endpoints.desc: Returns 200 with the coupon's status: applied (amount, covered items, items not covered and why) or rejected (reason). Account coupons for guests return needs_sign_in. Codes are carried into checkout and evaluated again there.

endpoints.summary: Merge the guest cart into the customer cart after sign-in
endpoints.desc: Send with the customer session and the guest session id in the body. Proof of ownership: the account must have claimed that guest session at sign-in or registration (identity.guest_session.claimed, recorded by cart's consumer); knowing the id is not enough, and an unclaimed or unknown session answers NOT_FOUND. Normally the merge has already happened through that event; this call returns its report (or merges now if the event has not arrived yet). Same offer: quantities combine up to the limit. Different offer for the same variant: both lines kept. Unavailable guest lines are dropped with a note; guest lines beyond maxLines are dropped too (outcome dropped_unavailable, note 'Your cart is full'). The guest's saved-for-later items move to the customer in the same transaction (owner_kind customer, customer_id set, guest_session_id cleared; when the customer already saved that offer the customer's row is kept and the guest row deleted). Idempotent by guest cart: a second call returns the same report.

endpoints.summary: Move a line to Saved for later
Move a saved item back into the cart
Find a customer's or guest's cart (support)
endpoints.desc: Read-only, for answering 'my cart changed' questions. Guest carts are found by guest session id from a support case.

endpoints.summary: One cart with lines, notices and merge history

consumes.does: Queue lines holding the offer for a notice refresh (price increased or decreased)

consumes.does: Queue lines; an ended or hidden offer becomes an offer_ended blocking notice

consumes.name: inventory.stock.changed

permissions.desc: Read customers' and guests' carts for support

jobs.name: cart.recheck-queued
jobs.does: Refresh notices for lines queued by offer, stock and seller events so the next read is fast; GET /cart still re-checks authoritatively

jobs.name: cart.expire-idle
jobs.does: Expire guest carts idle longer than guestCartRetentionDays and customer carts idle longer than customerCartRetentionDays; publishes cart.cart.expired

settings.desc: Idle days before a guest cart expires ('Items stay in your cart for 30 days')
Idle days before a customer cart expires

Distinct lines (offers) per cart. Adding a new offer to a full cart is CART_FULL (more of an offer already in the cart is still allowed); at sign-in merge, guest lines that would go beyond it are dropped and listed in the report

Platform line maximum: no line holds more units than this, whatever the offer's purchase limit and stock (the line maximum is the smallest of the offer limit, the deal limit, available stock and this)
Show an info notice when a price drops (accepted automatically)
Coupon attempts per owner per hour

OFFER_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The offer is ended, hidden, out of stock or its seller cannot sell now. details.reason, details.alternatives (count, lowest price).

QUANTITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.meaning: Requested quantity is above the purchase limit or available stock. details.max, details.limitKind (purchase_limit|stock|line_maximum).

CART_FULL.meaning: The cart already has the maximum number of lines. details.max.

OFFER_MISMATCH.meaning: The chosen offer is for a different variant than the line.

notes: Dependencies: architecture lists offers and inventory. catalog is optional and only used for display fields that offers does not return; shipping (package estimates, coverage) and promotions (coupon preview, was-price) are optional so the cart still works with flat offer data when they are off; customers resolves saved address ids for the deliver-to location.

Owner resolution: a customer session uses the customer's cart; otherwise the X-Guest-Session header identifies the guest cart (guest sessions are issued by identity). Requests with neither get UNAUTHORIZED.
Never switch sellers: a line's offerId only changes through POST /cart/items/{id}/switch-offer. Alternatives are only hinted (count and lowest price), never applied.

Change detection runs on every GET /cart and before getCartForCheckout through offers.getOffers (one batch read of every line's offer, any status) and offers.revalidate (lines with offerId, quantity, acceptedTermsVersion, acceptedUnitPrice; postal code of the deliver-to location) plus inventory.getAvailability; OfferChange kinds map to notices (price → price_increased/price_decreased, availability → out_of_stock/quantity_reduced, delivery → delivery_estimate_changed or not_shippable, removed → offer_ended, seller_restricted → seller_unavailable, terms → terms_changed). Promotion-driven price changes come from promotions.priceOffers. Baseline = acceptedUnitPrice and the quantity the customer chose. Increases create a warning notice that must be accepted; decreases are info notices accepted automatically. Out of stock, offer ended, seller unavailable, product unavailable and not shippable are blocking: the line stays visible, is excluded from checkout and the rest of the cart is unchanged.

Packages: lines group by owner, seller, fulfilledBy and ship-from location (packageKey(ownerType, sellerId, fulfilledBy, shipsFrom), the same function as checkout), all taken from the offer's effective Offer.shipping; the line's profile and dispatch come from Offer.shipping too. Delivery estimate and shipping per package come from shipping.quoteOptions (with the package's fulfilledBy) for the default (cheapest eligible) method; checkout lets the customer pick other options. A Marketly-fulfilled package shows 'Ships from Marketly' and keeps the seller named. Package labels ('Package 2 of 3') are computed per view, not stored.

Quantity limits: the line maximum is min(offer purchase limit, deal purchase limit (promotions), available stock, maxQuantityPerLine); maxQuantityPerLine applies to every line, with or without an offer limit. maxLines caps distinct lines (CART_FULL). Per-customer limits that count earlier orders are enforced in checkout, which can read order history.

Merge on sign-in: same offer combines up to the limit; different offers for the same variant are both kept (kept_separate_offer); unavailable guest lines are dropped and listed in the report; guest coupon codes are carried over when still valid; guest saved-for-later items move to the customer, deduplicated on (customer_id, offer_id).

Promotions input: cart passes every line to promotions.evaluateCart with a non-empty sellerId (the seller id, or OFFICIAL_STORE_ID from common constants for Official Store lines; never '' or null) and categoryId when known (null otherwise). Checkout does the same. CheckoutCartLine.sellerId itself stays null for the Official Store, as in offers.
The cart never reserves stock. Reservations start at Place order in checkout.
Save for later is listed in the plan as a later addition (ch. 6) and belongs with saved shopping (Growth), so its endpoints are phase 3. 'Tell me when it's back' is a wishlist alert (phase 3).
